# 2 Baruch Chapter 68 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**68:1** "And-those-black-waters which-you-saw which-followed-the-sixth-bright-waters and-darkened-them: these-are-the-deeds-of-all-the-rulers-of-Babylon, and-those-who-followed their-ways."

**68:2** "For-they-came-and-destroyed-Zion, and-carried-the-people-into-captivity, and-threw-down the-walls-of-Jerusalem, and-burned-the-temple-which-the-LORD had-built."

**68:3** "And-they-made-the-holy-vessels-of-the-sanctuary into-impure-things; and-they-scattered-the-children-of-Israel among-the-Gentiles."

**68:4** "And-they-gave-the-people-of-Zion to-their-enemies; and-the-holy-city-was-handed-over to-the-nations."

**68:5** "And-they-scattered-all-the-holy-things of-the-LORD, and-they-were-added-to-the-abominations-of-the-nations."

**68:6** "These-are-the-seventh-black-waters which-you-saw."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
